question: Does an episode-level common encoding state improve the joint correct/self-consistent-error/self-inconsistent ranking composition beyond a marginally matched relation-shared control while preserving the replicated global-decay learner?

theory.supported_parent_link: Finite-precision four-valued evidence combined with global blockwise diminishing plasticity improves internal ordering and ranking composition on development fits and three unchanged fresh replications.
theory.remaining_boundary: Self-consistent incorrect classifications remain above the frozen human-reference upper bound even though the other principal behavioral means are retained.
theory.candidate_link: A subject-level state shared across different relations within one episode can redistribute encoding errors across subjects without changing any single presentation's quantization distribution.
theory.excluded_interpretation: The candidate is not an overconfidence correction, an increase in mean sensory precision, a relation-familiarity mechanism, or a biological implementation.

parent_evidence.use_restriction: Confirmation seeds 2120--2122 may enter only the registered fixed-parameter substitution analysis after rho is locked. They cannot select rho, an encoder, a threshold, or a training recipe.

forbidden: Liu endpoint values during rho selection

encoder.near_probability: p_t is the existing stochastic-rounding probability for the code adjacent in the registered interpolation direction; deterministic codebook values remain deterministic.
encoder.copula: U_(s,t)=Phi(sqrt(rho) A_(s,g(t))+sqrt(1-rho) epsilon_(s,t)); choose the registered upper adjacent code iff U_(s,t)<p_t.

conditions.independent: rho=0; every presentation uses its idiosyncratic epsilon draw.
conditions.relation_common: g(t) is the ordinary-cue relation address; one A_(s,r) is shared only across repetitions of that relation.
conditions.episode_common: g(t) is the episode; one A_s is shared across every admitted relation and repetition in that episode.

encoder.primary_control_logic: episode_common minus relation_common isolates cross-relation common state while matching rho, each presentation's marginal distribution, and within-relation repetition dependence.
encoder.marginal_identity: For every condition and presentation U_(s,t) is marginally Uniform(0,1), hence code probabilities, conditional mean and conditional variance match the original Resampled codec exactly.
encoder.latent_independence: A and epsilon are independent of cues, admission, support order, displayed magnitude, targets, queries and choice draws.
encoder.orientation: The existing canonical ordinary-cue orientation and antisymmetric reconstruction are unchanged.

rho_selection.likelihood: Use the exact Bernoulli likelihood conditional on the Gaussian shared state and fixed Gauss-Hermite integration over that state. The observed per-presentation p_t and ordinary-cue relation grouping are the only covariates.
rho_selection.architecture_recovery_gate: At a rho grid point, each of independent, relation_common and episode_common must be selected under its own generator in at least 90% of 128 untouched recovery datasets, and each Wilson 95% lower bound must exceed 0.84.
rho_selection.rho_recovery_gate: Within the correctly selected relation_common and episode_common architectures, the generating rho grid point must maximize likelihood in at least 80% of datasets.
rho_selection.selection_rule: Select the smallest rho grid point passing every architecture- and rho-recovery gate. If none passes, stop before training and before any Liu cohort is generated or evaluated.
rho_selection.claim_boundary: The selected rho is a minimally identifiable generic perturbation strength, not an estimate of human common-state variance.

training.paired_task_stream: Within each seed, all encoder conditions receive identical generic task episodes. Registered normal streams are paired by shape and source seed but transformed only according to the condition.
training.optimization: Each fit is trained from initialization in one final-margin optimization stage. Rho is frozen and receives no gradient.
training.artifact_rule: All nine fits must finish and be jointly locked before generic competence confirmation or Liu evaluation.

fixed_parameter_substitution.parameters: Use the three frozen adaptive global-decay fits from fresh replication seeds 2120--2122 without retraining.
fixed_parameter_substitution.purpose: Estimate the direct consequence of changing only the encoder's joint sampling structure.
fixed_parameter_substitution.pairing: Each frozen fit is evaluated under independent, relation_common and episode_common encodings on identical locked cohorts and paired latent streams.

generic_gates.marginal_parity: Enumerated and Monte Carlo code probabilities, means and variances match independent Resampled within registered numerical and binomial tolerances for every condition.
generic_gates.binding: Relation-shared draws bind only by canonical ordinary-cue relation address; episode-shared draws bind only within a subject episode; query labels and hidden ranks cannot affect either.
generic_gates.competence: For every trained fit independently, learned and nonlearned exact correctness have participant/episode-bootstrap 95% lower bounds above 0.5.
generic_gates.global_decay: Every model uses the already replicated global schedule and passes its frozen late-sensitivity and numerical-reference checks.

liu_evaluation.pairing: Base Liu episodes, admission states, idiosyncratic normals, relation normals, episode normals and choice draws are generated prospectively and locked before any candidate rollout.
liu_evaluation.network_inference: Every seed and every fixed substitution is analyzed independently; participants are never pooled across fits or networks.
mandatory_report: mean inversion count and inversion bins
the complete frozen nine-endpoint quantitative profile

primary_estimands.mechanism_contrast: episode_common minus relation_common at the same selected rho
secondary_contrasts: trained minus fixed-parameter response within encoder

primary_success_rules.fixed_encoder_specificity: For each frozen 2120--2122 fit independently, the paired-cohort 95% interval for episode_common minus relation_common is above zero for correct_ranker and below zero for both self_consistent_incorrect and ranking-composition total variation.
primary_success_rules.trained_encoder_specificity: For each 2123--2125 seed independently, the same three directional paired-cohort intervals pass for the from-scratch episode_common fit versus its relation_common control.
primary_success_rules.joint_allocation: For every episode_common fit, self_inconsistent remains within its frozen human-reference interval; improvements cannot be counted if they merely move mass from self-consistent error into inconsistency.
primary_success_rules.internal_localization: Internal strict-correct, inversion, and internal-to-sampled transitions are mandatory mechanistic diagnostics but are not individually required to move if the registered joint-composition links pass.
primary_success_rules.preservation: Every trained episode_common fit passes the unchanged core-behavior and six-outcome preservation gates; learned and nonlearned accuracy cannot materially decrease under the inherited margins.
primary_success_rules.all_seed_rule: No pooled-network decision is allowed. Every registered primary link must pass independently in all three corresponding fits.

outcome_tree.common_encoding_supported: Generic rho recovery and all fixed-parameter, trained-recipe, joint-allocation and preservation gates pass.
outcome_tree.fixed_effect_only: The fixed-parameter encoder contrast passes but trained specificity fails; common sampling has a direct effect but is not stably retained under joint adaptation.
outcome_tree.coadaptation_only: Trained specificity passes but fixed substitution fails; the result cannot establish a direct common-state mechanism and is limited to recipe-level co-adaptation.
outcome_tree.joint_structure_unresolved: Generic recovery passes but neither complete mechanism route passes.
outcome_tree.noninterpretable: Rho recovery, marginal identity, binding, source lock, competence, global-decay, or artifact/input integrity fails.

stop_rule.after_failure: Do not tune rho on Liu, change the codebook, temperature, decay, loss, local branch, classifier, threshold, seed, checkpoint, or common-state grouping to rescue a failed result.
stop_rule.after_success: A successful development study remains a candidate mechanism. It requires unchanged fresh replication and a separate biological-boundary test before main-model promotion.
stop_rule.full_distribution_boundary: Failure to place every one of nine endpoint means inside a human interval does not by itself reject the candidate; the registered joint-composition and preservation estimands govern this study.
